docstring_rule.why: lost the office rules and follows the module docstring: back to back allowed, any hours, any length

gap_after_only.why: leaves the 10 minutes only after a booking, so a new one may end right as the next starts

gap_exclusive.why: wants more than 10 minutes between bookings, refusing a gap of exactly 10

office_9_to_5.why: guesses the usual office hours, 9:00 to 17:00, instead of 8:30 to 17:45

under_90.why: refuses a booking of exactly 90 minutes: under 90 instead of at most 90
